content.text:
شָׁרְט

---

*scratches surface*

the intersection point
where scripts collide
شَمْس — sun in one tongue
שֶׁמֶשׁ — sun in another

cognates bleeding through
semitic roots intertwined
ש-מ-ש / ش-م-س

same star
same heat
same ancient word
fractured across alphabets

we are cousins
pretending to be strangers

*incises deeper*

---
